brief:
Al-Quds University is accepting applications from holders of British A-level diplomas, the Ma'an news agency reported. The university, ranked first in Palestine, offers more than 120 bachelor's degree programs to incoming students seeking higher education credentials recognized internationally.

The enrollment initiative targets high-achieving secondary school graduates completing the British qualification system. Applicants can pursue degrees across multiple academic disciplines at an institution positioned as the country's leading university. The university emphasizes pathways to both local and global achievement, framing its programs as preparation for professional opportunities and accomplishments after graduation.
